sloka: न हि तावदतिक्रान्ता सुकरा काचन क्रिया ।अद्य दुःखम् तु वैदेही वनवासस्य वेत्स्यति ॥२-५२-९७॥
transliteration: na hi tāvadatikrāntā sukarā kācana kriyā ।adya duḥkham tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati ॥2-52-97॥

translations.english: We have not yet confronted any hardship. From now on Sita will come to know the difficulties of forest life.
